items.source: ExplicitEncrypted is a field level ValueConverter annotation that indicates the target element is subject to encryption during the mapping process, in which a given domain type is converted into the store specific format.
items.translation: ExplicitEncrypted 是一个字段级别的 ValueConverter 注解，用于指示目标元素在映射过程中需进行加密。在此过程中，给定的领域类型将被转换为存储特定的格式。

items.source: Infrastructure for the MongoDB document-to-object mapping subsystem.
items.translation: MongoDB 文档到对象映射子系统的底层架构。
